scenarios: If the runner enters the FallbackModel as a context manager (as pydantic-ai's Agent does internally), its __aexit__ closes all sub-model clients; then ProviderSession.close() closes the same clients a second time — httpx raises a RuntimeError on double-close of an AsyncClient.

If FallbackModel's __aenter__/__aexit__ is never invoked (bypassed), sub-model providers' HTTP client lifecycle is not managed by pydantic-ai's own mechanism, which may conflict with how pydantic-ai expects to use the clients it creates.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Clarify whether `httpx.ConnectTimeout` (which classifies as `RETRY_NOW`, same as `ConnectError`) should also trigger fallover, and update the `fallback_on` enumeration in the DECIDED section and the in-code documentation accordingly.

findings.finding: The plan's `fallback_on` taxonomy discussion enumerates `httpx.ConnectError`, `httpx.TimeoutException`, and `ModelAPIError` as transport failures that trigger failover, but omits `httpx.ConnectTimeout`.
